promises.promise: PrompTED never presents a blank document as a successful result.
requiredEvidence: Generated sections are validated before workspace display
Generation failures produce a plain-English recovery state

promises.promise: A user's original imported document remains safe and recoverable.
requiredEvidence: Authenticated originals are retained in private storage
Imported sections begin with an original-content version
Failed persistence does not create a partial workspace

promises.promise: TED does not silently turn uncertain parsing into a permanent document structure.
requiredEvidence: Import review occurs before workspace creation
Uncertain sections are labelled in plain English
Users can rename, split, merge and remove sections

promises.promise: Document changes are reversible and their origin is understandable.
requiredEvidence: Restore operations preserve the current version first

promises.promise: Generated documents contain final wording rather than prompts or code-like instructions.
requiredEvidence: Fixture tests cover common prompt-leak patterns
Recovery regenerates only the affected section

promises.promise: Users can tell whether their work is saved locally, synced, or needs attention.
requiredEvidence: Workspace shows save and sync status
Failed sync offers a specific retry action
